name: Piglet's House
steps: Tap logs to place wooden planks.
Tap deer antlers for frame support.
Tap turtle shell for roof strength.
Tap river stone for heavy support.
Tap rubber plugs for flexible layer.
Tap beehive to use honey for sticking.
Drag golden shovel to dirt to dig treasure.
Tap gold nuggets in chest for golden layer.
Tap tin sheets for metal protection.
Tap thorn vines for spike defense.
Tap bamboo for strong outer layer.
